text: Leuk arrived with the rising sun, stepping lightly between the furrows with his woven baskets.
He freed Bouki with a bowl of warm groundnut oil, but sent him away with empty paws.
'You sought to eat from sweat you never shed,' Leuk said gently as the shame-faced hyena slunk into the tall savanna grass.
And from that day forward, the animals of the grasslands remembered: in the community field, the seeds are planted by patience, but the harvest is reaped by truth.
